identity.title: Governed AI Study Basics for Nursing Students

purpose.subject: Working with AI as a nursing student, the governed way
purpose.audience: Nursing students and assistants (FUTURE lane); useful to any nurse starting a personal AI system
intended_use: Personal study of governed AI habits: draft-and-attest, memory hygiene, hypothesis discipline
A worked example of the Knowledge Pack format for the personal library pilot
prohibited_use: Clinical decision support or bedside guidance of any kind
Institutional policy, academic-integrity ruling, or accreditation evidence

governance.accountable_human: the nurse who accepts this pack into their personal library
stop_conditions: Any request to apply this content to a real patient situation
Any conflict with the reader's school or institutional policy — the policy governs
Discovery of PHI or person-identifiable content in any pack file

sources.title: Personal Memory Fabric Kit — vault structure
Personal Memory Fabric Kit — trust ledger
Personal Memory Fabric Kit — monthly memory review
Nurse Formation doctrine (commit-then-compare, human evaluative authority)

evidence.evidence_status: Doctrine-derived study guidance; no clinical evidence, learning-outcome evidence, or examination-success evidence is claimed
limitations: Describes working habits, not any school's academic-integrity policy
Tool-agnostic: specific AI products' settings and behavior may differ
Educational content only; verification standards for coursework and clinical settings are set locally

review.independent_review: None. Publication to any shared catalog requires independent review per knowledge-commons/PLAYBOOK.md §8.2; one person is never presented as two reviewers. This pack is held at state 'draft' until that review happens.
